## Details

<a id="animate_rockford"></a>
### [`animate_rockford`](../../../../src/screen/animation.asm#L6) `$7BC2`

*routine*

Copies one byte row of the Rockford characters $4C, $4D, $5C and $5D. Input: X = frame offset, Y = byte row 0-7. Walking uses the left or right frames. Standing uses the standing image, with random eye blinks and foot taps.

- **Called from:** [`animate_chars`](animation.md#animate_chars)
- **Calls:** [`random_from_timers`](../engine/random.md#random_from_timers)
- **Reads:** [`joystick_dir`](../../memory-map.md#joystick_dir), [`rockford_facing`](../../memory-map.md#rockford_facing), [`rockford_right_tl`](../rockford/rockford_glyphs.md#rockford_right_tl), [`rockford_right_tr`](../rockford/rockford_glyphs.md#rockford_right_tr), [`rockford_right_bl`](../rockford/rockford_glyphs.md#rockford_right_bl), [`rockford_right_br`](../rockford/rockford_glyphs.md#rockford_right_br), [`rockford_left_tl`](../rockford/rockford_glyphs.md#rockford_left_tl), [`rockford_left_tr`](../rockford/rockford_glyphs.md#rockford_left_tr), [`rockford_left_bl`](../rockford/rockford_glyphs.md#rockford_left_bl), [`rockford_left_br`](../rockford/rockford_glyphs.md#rockford_left_br), [`rockford_tap`](../../memory-map.md#rockford_tap), [`rockford_blink`](../../memory-map.md#rockford_blink) and 8 more

<a id="animate_chars"></a>
### [`animate_chars`](../../../../src/screen/animation.asm#L80) `$7C61`

*routine*

Shows the status line during play. Then copies the current animation frame (anim_frame) into the characters of the diamond and of Rockford. Also the amoeba, the butterfly and the firefly characters, as cave_anim_flags selects.

- **Called from:** [`animate_cave`](animate_cave.md#animate_cave)
